task: Code Review: Dispatch Service & API Route
workflow_steps: 2. Project Discovery — read dispatch service, search for API route, scan folder structure
3. Database Analysis — read schema migrations (001, 002, 003, 005), seed.sql
4. Security Review — read RLS policies, client/server/admin supabase clients
5. Business Logic Review — trace state machines, side effects, data consistency across dispatch ↔ reservation ↔ vehicle ↔ driver

10. Compile findings into structured report with severity ratings
